messages.subject: Nvim-R 0.9.6 is released
parts:
Version 0.9.6 of Nvim-R is released. The changes are:
  • New option: R_open_example.
  • Change default value of R_source_args to "print.eval=TRUE".
  • Change in \aa and \ae: do not save the buffer before sending the whole file to R.
Now there are two ways of installing released versions:
  • Vimball: http://www.vim.org/scripts/script.php?script_id=2628
  • Vim package: https://github.com/jalvesaq/Nvim-R/releases
I am no longer distributing the nvimcom binary. Consequently, Rtools is required even for those installing released versions of the plugin.
